title: quercus brantii var. persica
intro: Quercus brantii var. persica, commonly known as Eastern Persian oak, is a plant species belonging to the Quercus genus and is native to the mountainous regions of Iran and surrounding areas. The plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which can help to alleviate various health conditions. The therapeutic actions of Quercus brantii var. persica include its ability to modulate immune responses, exhibit antimicrobial and antifungal properties, and act as an anti-diarrheal agent. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and tannins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and are responsible for its therapeutic actions.
